name: Bullpen — Part 6 (planned)
description: Prediction, not yet built, and the retrospective part of the series: a Leaderboard Service ranks players within leagues. The stock data provider proposed in Part 3 (Alpha Vantage, pending written permission — see ADR-0008) carries forward unchanged; no payments provider is part of this plan. Part 6 of the actual series will compare this prediction against what really shipped.

nodes.name: Reader
nodes.description: A blog reader exploring Bullpen's architecture timeline on the landing site.

nodes.name: Player
nodes.description: A registered player competing in a league and checking the leaderboard.

nodes.name: Bullpen Landing
nodes.description: The public landing site with the architecture timeline explorer, now covering all six parts.

nodes.name: Bullpen Trading App
nodes.description: The trading app where players trade, view leagues, and check the leaderboard.

nodes.name: Prices Service
nodes.description: Owns live price snapshots, sourced from the stock data provider proposed since Part 3.

nodes.name: Prices Database
nodes.description: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Prices Service.

nodes.name: Market History Service
nodes.description: Serves historical price/candle queries independently of live snapshots, with its own write path and own database.

nodes.name: Market History Database
nodes.description: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Market History Service.

nodes.name: Orders Service
nodes.description: Accepts paper trade order requests and publishes them onto the market-open queue.

nodes.name: Market Open Queue
nodes.description: Buffers the burst of order requests at market open so the Order Saga consumes them at a sustainable rate.

nodes.name: Order Saga
nodes.description: Durable workflow orchestrating each queued order: price lookup, balance check, fill, and ledger update.

nodes.name: Ledger Service
nodes.description: Owns player balances and positions; the source of truth the Leaderboard Service ranks against.

nodes.name: Leaderboard Service
nodes.description: Ranks players within leagues from ledger balances and positions; leagues are groups of players competing over the same period.

nodes.name: Stock data provider
nodes.description: External market-data API for U.S. stock prices. Alpha Vantage is proposed (free tier, end of day), pending written permission for public display — see ADR-0008. Carried forward unchanged from Part 3.

relationships.description: Reader browses the public landing site.
Trading app requests a live price snapshot for a symbol.
Trading app requests historical price/candle data for a symbol.
Trading app submits a paper trade order request.
Trading app requests the current league leaderboard.
Orders Service publishes each accepted order onto the market-open queue.
Order saga consumes queued orders at a sustainable rate.
Order saga consults the Prices Service for the fill price.
Order saga updates the player's balance and positions once a trade fills.
Leaderboard Service reads player balances and positions to compute rankings.
Prices Service persists and reads live price snapshots.
Market History Service persists and reads historical price/candle data.
Prices Service calls out to the external market-data provider for the current price.
